_note: Discussion posted onto the pull requests by seed_github.py. All from one GitHub account, so each comment is prefixed with who said it in the fiction. Ordered chronologically per PR.

PAY-3.author: petra
PAY-3.body:
petra: skimmed it, matches what we agreed in ADR-0002 - authorise() returns a result, orders writes it onto the order, done. nothing to argue with here.

ping me when refunds are in and I'll do a proper pass

PAY-3.author: tomas
PAY-3.body:
Tomas: hold on, every charge above 30 CZK is coming back 402 sca_required since this morning:

```json
{
  "status": "sca_required",
  "challenge_url": "https://sandbox.fictionalbank.cz/3ds/challenge/ch_8f2a",
  "challenge_id": "ch_8f2a",
  "expires_in": 600
}
```

under 30 CZK still settles synchronously which is why CI is green btw, every fixture in the suite charges 25 CZK. nothing real actually works right now.

raised with the bank, ticket #4417. could be a sandbox glitch, waiting on their reply before touching anything

PAY-3.author: tomas
PAY-3.body:
Tomas: bank got back on #4417, not a glitch. quoting:

> Re your ticket - the sandbox merchant profile was migrated to the PSD2-compliant config on 26/09. SCA is mandatory for all txns above the 30 CZK low value exemption threshold, this is consistent with what your merchant account will have in production at go live. The earlier behaviour was down to a sandbox config error on our end, apologies for any confusion.

so the exemption from 2025-08-25 that we estimated against never actually existed. nothing to wait for, nothing to revert.

practically: charge becomes async, challenge -> customer authenticates at the bank -> result comes back on a webhook we don't have yet. a payment needs its own persisted lifecycle now, not a bool on the order. petra, sona - ADR coming but wanted you both to know now

PAY-3.author: petra
PAY-3.body:
**Medior dev, 2025-09-30**

Read ADR-0003. Agreed, don't see a better option.

1. this isn't the task we estimated - 40h was "wrap the client PAY-2 already built". what's in the ADR is a persisted state machine plus a whole inbound integration surface. different job, not the same job running late.
2. orders gets off easy, the ADR-0001 interface absorbs it, payment_id instead of a bool. PAY-4 still merges on time.

re-estimate it in Jira before continuing. if the hours keep going against the original 40h without that, nobody notices until it's already spent.

PAY-3.author: tomas
PAY-3.body:
Tomas: webhooks aren't what the guide promises. 7.1 says at-least-once in causal order, we get at-least-once and that's it. challenge.completed arrives twice, payment.captured sometimes lands before it.

state machine can't walk a sequence then. rewrote it as an event lookup, duplicate = no-op, order doesn't matter, idempotency store on (challenge_id, event_type). another day gone on this.

also found: customer abandons the bank page = no terminal event at all, sandbox never expires the challenge either. those payments just sit in pending_challenge. need a reconciliation poller, which needs a scheduler, which we don't have

PAY-3.author: sona
PAY-3.body:
**PM, 2025-10-06**

Catching up on this thread — where are we on hours, and what's the path to something mergeable?

I want to take the SCA change to the client. The exemption was confirmed by their bank in writing before we estimated, this is fixed price, so right now every one of these hours is on us. Need a number for the remaining work before I can open that conversation though.

PAY-3.author: tomas
PAY-3.body:
Tomas: every webhook started 400ing overnight. sandbox moved to v2.1, renamed the fields, no changelog no email:

| v2.0 | v2.1 |
|---|---|
| `challenge_result` | `authentication.status` |
| `charge_id` | `payment.id` |
| `result: "Y"/"N"` | `status: "authenticated"/"rejected"` |

ticket #4468, their answer was that v2.1 was "announced in the developer portal" which we don't have access to.

parser rewritten with version negotiation so this can't happen silently again - second rewrite of this thing in a week.

will get sona a number tomorrow

PAY-3.author: tomas
PAY-3.body:
Tomas: where this actually stands.

working - authorise up to the challenge, redirect URL, webhook receipt and verification, idempotency, state machine for the happy path, v2.0/v2.1 negotiation.

not working, each of these blocks a merge on its own:
- refunds. bank wants the original authentication reference to refund an SCA charge and we never stored it. schema change plus a backfill.
- persistence. repository is in memory, a deploy loses every in-flight payment.
- reconciliation job. not started, needs a scheduler we don't have.

best guess to minimum mergeable is 20-25h. that's a guess not an estimate, nobody has broken it out properly.

should've opened this for review two weeks ago instead of continuing to work on it. three weeks of hours in here and nothing merged.

PAY-3.author: sona
PAY-3.body:
**PM, 2025-10-10**

Stopping work on this today.

Before another hour goes in: PR comes out of draft for review as-is, and tomas + petra break the 20-25h out into actual line items so we know what a minimum mergeable gateway is. Then we descope to exactly that path so PAY-5 and PAY-6 can finish.

Taking the SCA change to the client in parallel — ADR-0003 and the bank's reply on #4417 are the evidence, they told us in writing on 2025-08-25 that the exemption applied and changed it on 2025-09-26.

Nothing else starts on this until both of those exist.

PAY-5.author: tomas
PAY-5.body:
Tomas: on the return URL, contract isn't settled yet sorry. what I can tell you - customer may come back before the webhook lands, so the return screen can't assume the payment is resolved, needs to poll or show pending.

third screen on top of your two basically, not in your 40h. flag it to sona rather than just absorbing it

PAY-6.author: marek
PAY-6.body:
marek: for the record on the 25 CZK fixtures, that one's on QA. suite stayed green for two days after the sandbox changed because every fixture sat under the exemption threshold - found out from a manual test instead of CI catching it.

fixtures use realistic amounts now. everything downstream of gateway stays blocked until that PR has a stable interface. 12h of 35h used, remaining 23h still ahead of us
